whatIs: Ant Design is a design system and a React component library aimed at enterprise applications. It includes TypeScript types, internationalization support and a customizable theming system based on CSS-in-JS.
It's a good fit when you're building dashboards, forms and internal tools, and you prefer a complete, consistent library over assembling each piece yourself.
uses: Building an admin dashboard with tables, forms and filters.
Offering an application in several languages using its internationalization guide.
Adjusting the colors and style to a company's brand through its themes.
caveats: It's a large library with a very distinct style of its own; moving away from its look takes customization work.
The current version only supports React 18 or later, since React 16 and 17 were dropped starting with v6.
It doesn't work in Internet Explorer: support ended with v5.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; install it with npm install antd.
idealFor: Enterprise applications and admin dashboards in React.
